Criteria for Approval:
• Diagnosis of chronic obstructive pulmonary disorder (COPD); AND
• Trial and failure of ≥ 1 inhaled therapy; AND
• Documentation (e.g., progress notes) of FEV₁ ≤ 50% of predicted.

Quantity Limit: 1 per day

Approval Duration: 6 months initial; 1 year renewal

• Diagnosis of moderate to severe chronic obstructive pulmonary disorder;
AND
• Trial and failure of at least a 2-week trial of standard of care therapy:
○ Triple-ingredient therapy (inhaled corticosteroids [ICS], long-acting beta agonist [LABA], and long-acting muscarinic antagonist [LAMA]);
OR
○ Dual-ingredient therapy (long-acting beta agonist [LABA]/long-acting muscarinic agent [LAMA])
AND
• Patient meets the minimum age recommended by the package insert.

Renewal Criteria:
• Clinically significant improvement or stabilization in signs and symptoms.

Age Limit: ≥ 18 years
Quantity Limit: 5 mL per day
